retained_attempts.cause: Benchmark omitted expected_structure_revision after gameplay template spawning; native player.start correctly rejected the request. Harness corrected before GPU measurement.

retained_attempts.scope: Five-second warm-up and 30-second RTX measurement; power/display not observed at run time and final tester source does not identify this earlier run. Final .94 cohorts provide the frozen current-source evidence.

owner_closure.scope: Exact recorded benchmark endpoints only; unrelated native windows are preserved.

limitations: One development laptop; short 30-second warm-up and 60-second measurement per GPU, not the 30-minute reliability gate or clean-machine support.
Application present-return cadence is not display scanout FPS or click-to-photon latency; OS display mode does not establish VRR.
Imported Idle spectators and shared simple boxes are not production FPS assets, crowd AI or GPU instancing qualification; spectators can overlap the camera near circuit corners.
Skinning diagnostics include shadow-only geometry; they do not prove all 24 rigs are camera-visible.
Dynamic bodies can settle; not sustained contact-heavy physics. Autonomous navigation belongs to one player controller.
Audio callbacks/mixer counters are observed, but physical input and audibility are unqualified.
Working set and private commit are separate sampled process metrics; GPU memory/residency and system-wide resource costs are unqualified.
Existing caches and a fresh process/cold scene upload; no clean-cache, thermal-soak or edit-to-play qualification.
No engine API, schema, gameplay services or renderer algorithm change; this checkpoint adds a reproducible workload and measurement evidence.
